title: Subtraction to 50
subtitle: Take away from 21 to 50
bounds: Minuends 21-50, a and b at least 2 (T1 allows 1). T1 R with a multiple of 10 as a or b; T2 R no trade (the ones of s at least the ones of a), at least 8 with a one-digit part and 8 with both parts at least 10; T3 R with a trade, same two floors; T4 s − ? = b, at least 12 with a trade, no multiples of 10; T5 ? − a = b (at least 12, 6 with a trade) and s − ? = b (6 with a trade), no multiples of 10. Wrong choices: distinct non-negative integers up to 999, at least two within 1, 2 or 10 of the answer, at most one far; where the answer is 20 or more one wrong choice shares its ones digit; modelled misconceptions first, ARITH only to fill; each answer rank (smallest to largest of the four) holds the answer in 15-35% of a tier.

tiers.name: Trading a ten
tiers.description: Trade a ten: 42 − 17. Count up to check.

tiers.name: Missing first numbers
tiers.description: The start is hidden: ? − 17 = 25. Add back.

ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Check: answer + number taken away must equal the start.
ONE_OFF.teacher: Counted back one step too many or too few: answer is the correct difference plus or minus 1.

ADDED.student: Take away, don't add. Subtracting makes the number smaller.
ADDED.teacher: Added the two numbers (s + a) instead of subtracting.

SMALLER_FROM_LARGER.student: Don't flip digits. If the top digit is smaller, trade a ten for 10 ones.
SMALLER_FROM_LARGER.teacher: In each place takes the smaller digit from the larger (14 - 6 gives 12; 52 - 38 gives 26) instead of regrouping.

FORGOT_TRADE.student: You traded a ten for ones, so the tens digit has to drop by one.
FORGOT_TRADE.teacher: Regrouped the ones but left the tens unchanged: answer is 10 too big (14 - 6 gives 18; 52 - 38 gives 24).

TENS_SLIP.student: The tens are off by one ten. Check: answer + taken away = start.
TENS_SLIP.teacher: Right ones, tens digit one too high or too low: answer is the correct difference plus or minus 10.

MISSING_ADDED.student: Add the missing part to what is left and you must get the start. Check it.
MISSING_ADDED.teacher: s - ? = b: added the two numbers shown (s + b) instead of finding what was taken away.

MISSING_ONE_OFF.student: Off by one. Put your number back in the problem and check it.
MISSING_ONE_OFF.teacher: Missing number is one too big or too small (the answer plus or minus 1); did not check by substituting.

MISSING_TENS.student: Off by one ten. Put your number back in the problem and check it.
MISSING_TENS.teacher: Right ones, tens digit one too high or too low: the missing number plus or minus 10 (trade forgotten or tens slip).

START_SUBTRACTED.student: The start is bigger than both numbers: add back what was taken away.
START_SUBTRACTED.teacher: ? - a = b: took the two shown numbers apart (|b - a|) instead of adding back what was taken.

START_NO_CARRY.student: Adding back, the ones made a ten: carry it. Check: start − taken = left.
START_NO_CARRY.teacher: ? - a = b: added the ones but dropped the carried ten, so the start is 10 too small.

items.explanation: 42 − 2 = 40: the ones are 2 − 2 = 0, the tens stay.
37 − 7 = 30: the ones are 7 − 7 = 0, the tens stay.
44 − 4 = 40: the ones are 4 − 4 = 0, the tens stay.
46 − 6 = 40: the ones are 6 − 6 = 0, the tens stay.
39 − 8 = 31: the ones are 9 − 8 = 1, the tens stay.
26 − 5 = 21: the ones are 6 − 5 = 1, the tens stay.
37 − 3 = 34: the ones are 7 − 3 = 4, the tens stay.
49 − 2 = 47: the ones are 9 − 2 = 7, the tens stay.
36 − 3 = 33: the ones are 6 − 3 = 3, the tens stay.
22 − 7: take 2 to get 20, then take 5 more: 15.
42 − 34: count up from 34 to 42, 8 steps. Check: 34 + 8 = 42.
50 − 36: count up from 36 to 50, 14 steps. Check: 36 + 14 = 50.
50 − 42: count up from 42 to 50, 8 steps. Check: 42 + 8 = 50.
24 − 15: count up from 15 to 24, 9 steps. Check: 15 + 9 = 24.
44 − 6: take 4 to get 40, then take 2 more: 38.
24 − 19: count up from 19 to 24, 5 steps. Check: 19 + 5 = 24.
30 − 22: count up from 22 to 30, 8 steps. Check: 22 + 8 = 30.
36 − ? = 28: count up from 28 to 36, that is 8. So 36 − 8 = 28, ? = 8.
30 − ? = 24: count up from 24 to 30, that is 6. So 30 − 6 = 24, ? = 6.
23 − ? = 8: count up from 8 to 23, that is 15. So 23 − 15 = 8, ? = 15.
31 − ? = 28: count up from 28 to 31, that is 3. So 31 − 3 = 28, ? = 3.
37 − ? = 18: count up from 18 to 37, that is 19. So 37 − 19 = 18, ? = 19.
40 − ? = 32: count up from 32 to 40, that is 8. So 40 − 8 = 32, ? = 8.
42 − ? = 37: count up from 37 to 42, that is 5. So 42 − 5 = 37, ? = 5.
22 − ? = 15: count up from 15 to 22, that is 7. So 22 − 7 = 15, ? = 7.
22 − ? = 16: count up from 16 to 22, that is 6. So 22 − 6 = 16, ? = 6.
31 − ? = 13: count up from 13 to 31, that is 18. So 31 − 18 = 13, ? = 18.
35 − ? = 24: count up from 24 to 35, that is 11. So 35 − 11 = 24, ? = 11.
? − 38 = 6: undo the take away, 6 + 38 = 44, so ? = 44. Check: 44 − 38 = 6.
? − 38 = 4: undo the take away, 4 + 38 = 42, so ? = 42. Check: 42 − 38 = 4.
? − 42 = 3: undo the take away, 3 + 42 = 45, so ? = 45. Check: 45 − 42 = 3.
? − 23 = 12: undo the take away, 12 + 23 = 35, so ? = 35. Check: 35 − 23 = 12.
? − 19 = 15: undo the take away, 15 + 19 = 34, so ? = 34. Check: 34 − 19 = 15.
40 − ? = 27: count up from 27 to 40, that is 13. So 40 − 13 = 27, ? = 13.
? − 9 = 37: undo the take away, 37 + 9 = 46, so ? = 46. Check: 46 − 9 = 37.
40 − ? = 32: count up from 32 to 40, that is 8. So 40 − 8 = 32, ? = 8.
? − 13 = 37: undo the take away, 37 + 13 = 50, so ? = 50. Check: 50 − 13 = 37.
32 − ? = 26: count up from 26 to 32, that is 6. So 32 − 6 = 26, ? = 6.
